name: Brüggen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of blue with a narrow yellow stripe near each edge, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Brüggen (a lion and a wavy bend on yellow and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Brüggen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Brüggen arms — lion and wavy bend
